introSection.heading: Understand Daily Gratuities, Service Charges and Tipping on Princess Cruises
introSection.p1: When planning a Princess Cruises holiday, it is worth understanding how gratuities work before you sail. Princess uses the term Crew Appreciation for its daily service charge, which recognises the many crew members who contribute to your onboard experience.
introSection.p2: The charge is generally added to your onboard account each day, unless it has already been prepaid or covered by an eligible package. Its amount depends on your stateroom category, and guests have the option to adjust it while onboard. There are also separate service charges on certain optional purchases, including drinks and specialty dining. These are not the same as daily Crew Appreciation.
introSection.p3: This guide explains Princess Cruises' gratuity rates, how much to budget, what Princess Plus and Princess Premier include, and whether you should consider tipping crew members separately.

whatAreGratuities.title: What Are Princess Cruises Gratuities?
whatAreGratuities.subtitle: Pooled Crew Appreciation Supporting Guest-Facing & Behind-the-Scenes Teams
whatAreGratuities.intro: Princess Cruises refers to its daily gratuities as Crew Appreciation. It is a per-person, per-day amount intended to recognise the work of crew members across the ship. Rather than being distributed only to the staff members guests interact with directly, the collected funds are pooled and distributed among eligible crew members in guest-facing and behind-the-scenes departments.

departments.title: Housekeeping & Staterooms
departments.description: Stateroom stewards and housekeeping staff who service cabins twice daily, manage linens, and maintain immaculate stateroom hallways.

departments.title: Dining Room & Restaurant Teams
departments.description: Head waiters, servers, assistant servers, and bus staff delivering multi-course meals across the main dining rooms and casual eateries.

departments.title: Bar & Beverage Staff
departments.description: Bartenders, bar servers, and sommeliers crafting cocktails, pouring wines, and preparing specialty coffees across shipboard lounges.

departments.title: Galley & Food Preparation
departments.description: Behind-the-scenes culinary teams, sous chefs, bakers, and line cooks preparing fresh cuisine, pastries, and buffet presentations 24/7.

departments.title: Entertainment & Production
departments.description: Audio, lighting, stage crews, activity staff, and production teams operating theater shows, music venues, and daily cruise activities.

departments.title: Guest Services & Hotel Operations
departments.description: Front desk receptionists, concierge staff, onboard revenue teams, and guest relations specialists resolving stateroom inquiries.

whatAreGratuities.note: This means the daily charge recognises a much wider team than just your stateroom attendant or dining server.

dailyRates.title: Princess Cruises Daily Gratuity Rates
dailyRates.subtitle: Current Published USD Crew Appreciation Rates by Stateroom Category
dailyRates.intro: Princess Cruises' current published Crew Appreciation amounts are based on your stateroom category. These amounts are in US dollars. Guests sailing on ships operating in Australian dollars are charged the equivalent amount in AUD, subject to the applicable regional policy. The charge applies per guest, per day, including children. The exact category assigned to your stateroom determines the applicable rate.

paymentMethods.title: How Are Princess Cruises Gratuities Charged?
paymentMethods.subtitle: Three Common Ways to Manage and Settle Crew Appreciation
paymentMethods.intro: If Crew Appreciation has not been prepaid or included in an eligible package, Princess generally adds the daily amount to your onboard account automatically. You can review charges through your onboard account in the Princess app. There are three common ways to handle payment:

cards.title: Pay Automatically Onboard
items: The daily amount is automatically posted to your stateroom folio every day of the voyage
Charges accumulate throughout the cruise and settle against your linked credit card on disembarkation morning
Convenient if you prefer paying at the end of the cruise rather than upfront before departure
Review real-time running balances daily in the Princess Cruises app

cards.title: Prepay Before Your Cruise
items: Prepay Crew Appreciation through Princess Manage Booking at any point prior to sailing
Locks in your gratuity budget before leaving home and reduces charges on your onboard account
Treated as part of your applicable cruise fare booking payment arrangements
Check payment deadlines in your booking; subject to regional terms and cancellation policies

cards.title: Covered by a Cruise Package
items: Princess Plus and Princess Premier packages pay Crew Appreciation on behalf of eligible guests
Daily service charges are automatically waived and will not appear on your stateroom bill
Combines gratuities with beverage packages, Wi-Fi, casual and specialty dining
Check package terms if booking onboard or sailing on ships operating under AUD currency rules

packageInclusions.title: Are Gratuities Included in Princess Plus and Princess Premier?
packageInclusions.subtitle: Crew Appreciation Fully Covered in Both All-Inclusive Bundles
packageInclusions.intro: Yes. Under the current USD package terms, both Princess Plus and Princess Premier include Crew Appreciation paid on behalf of eligible guests. This is a significant benefit because it covers the daily service charge and removes the need to manage that charge separately during the voyage.

serviceCharges.title: Are There Additional Service Charges on Princess Cruises?
serviceCharges.subtitle: Understanding the Automatic 20% Gratuity on Optional Onboard Purchases
serviceCharges.intro: Yes. Daily Crew Appreciation is separate from service charges applied to certain optional purchases. Princess' published policy states that an automatic 20% service charge is added to eligible optional purchases.

categories.title: Bar & Beverage Purchases
categories.description: A 20% service charge is automatically added to individual cocktails, glasses of wine, beers, sodas, and specialty coffees purchased a la carte outside of an active drink package.

categories.title: Specialty Dining Cover Charges
categories.description: A 20% service charge is added to cover charges and a la carte menus at Crown Grill, Sabatini's, The Catch by Rudi, and other specialty dining venues when paying out-of-pocket.

categories.title: Lotus Spa Treatments & Salon
categories.description: Spa treatments, massages, facials, and salon services automatically incur an 18% to 20% service charge added to the stateroom folio upon checkout.

categories.title: Private Group Functions & Corkage
categories.description: Private cocktail parties, catering arrangements, wine tasting seminars, and personal wine corkage fees (/bottle) carry applicable service charges.

serviceCharges.example: For example, if you purchase an optional specialty item for  that is subject to a 20% service charge, the additional charge is . Paying daily Crew Appreciation does not remove service charges on optional purchases, though beverage and dining packages cover applicable service charges for included items.

adjustingGratuities.title: Can You Adjust or Remove Princess Cruises Gratuities?
adjustingGratuities.subtitle: Onboard Discretion Policy and Important Timelines
adjustingGratuities.intro: Princess states that guests have discretion to adjust Crew Appreciation while onboard. If you have a concern about service, the first step should always be to speak with the onboard team so they have an opportunity to address it during your cruise.

rules.title: Onboard Adjustment Discretion
items: Crew Appreciation can be increased, reduced, or removed at the guest's discretion while onboard
Adjustments must be requested at Guest Services before settling your account prior to disembarkation
Once the stateroom account is finalized and closed on disembarkation morning, charges are non-refundable
Adjustments cannot be made retroactively after leaving the ship

rules.title: Package Benefit Rules
items: Guests who booked Princess Plus or Princess Premier have Crew Appreciation paid as a bundled perk
This component cannot be removed, refunded, credited, or exchanged for cash or onboard credit
Crew members still receive their pooled gratuity entitlement directly from Princess on your behalf
Package benefits remain governed by the terms of the original fare booking

additionalTipping.title: Should You Tip Princess Crew Members Extra?
additionalTipping.subtitle: When and How to Give Personal Cash Gratuities
additionalTipping.intro: Additional tipping is completely optional. Crew Appreciation is designed to recognise a broad group of crew members across the ship, so you are not expected to give additional tips simply because you received attentive service. However, guests are welcome to provide an additional tip directly to individual crew members who have gone above and beyond.

scenarios.title: Stateroom Stewards
scenarios.description: For exceptionally thoughtful cabin care, accommodating special requests, or delivering delightful daily towel animals and ice setups.

scenarios.title: Dining Room Servers
scenarios.description: For memorable evening dinner service, anticipating dietary preferences, and exceptional attention to wine pairings and courses.

scenarios.title: Bartenders & Bar Servers
scenarios.description: For talented mixologists who remember your favorite drinks and provide warm, personalized service in your favorite ship lounge.

scenarios.title: Special Requests & Luggage Porters
scenarios.description: For shoreside baggage handlers (– per bag at terminal drop-off) and crew who deliver extra assistance with mobility or celebrations.

additionalTipping.guidance: There is no required or standard amount for extra tips. Guests who choose to provide additional gratuities often give  to  in cash to their stateroom attendant or dining team at the end of the voyage. Any additional gratuity is a personal choice based on your experience and budget.

faqs.answer: The published daily Crew Appreciation rates are  USD per guest for Interior, Oceanview, and Balcony staterooms;  USD per guest for Mini-Suites, Cabanas, and Reserve Collection staterooms; and  USD per guest for Suites.

faqs.question: Are Princess Cruises gratuities automatically added?
faqs.answer: Yes. Unless Crew Appreciation has been prepaid prior to sailing or is included as part of an eligible Princess Plus or Princess Premier package, it is automatically posted to your stateroom folio on a daily basis.

faqs.question: Do children pay gratuities on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. The daily Crew Appreciation charge applies to every guest in the stateroom regardless of age, including infants and children, based on the stateroom category rate.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included in Princess Plus?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under current USD package terms, Princess Plus includes daily Crew Appreciation paid on behalf of eligible guests, along with the Plus Beverage Package, Wi-Fi, and casual dining.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included in Princess Premier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Princess Premier includes daily Crew Appreciation for all eligible guests, alongside the Premier Beverage Package, 4-device Wi-Fi, unlimited specialty and casual dining, and photo packages.

faqs.question: Can I prepay Princess Cruises gratuities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests can prepay their Crew Appreciation through Princess Manage Booking at any time up until the pre-cruise payment deadline, which locks in your gratuity budget before departure.

faqs.question: Can I remove or reduce Crew Appreciation?
faqs.answer: Princess allows guests to adjust or remove Crew Appreciation while onboard by visiting Guest Services prior to settling their account on disembarkation morning. After disembarkation, gratuities are finalized and non-refundable. Note that Crew Appreciation bundled into Princess Plus or Premier cannot be refunded or removed.

faqs.question: Is the 20% service charge the same as daily gratuities?
faqs.answer: No. Crew Appreciation is a daily per-person service charge supporting shipwide crew teams. The 20% service charge applies automatically to optional a la carte purchases such as cocktails, wine by the bottle, and specialty dining cover charges.

faqs.question: Should I tip my stateroom attendant separately?
faqs.answer: Additional tipping is completely optional. Daily Crew Appreciation already compensates stateroom stewards, dining servers, and behind-the-scenes staff. However, you are welcome to give extra cash directly to crew members who provide exceptional personal service.

faqs.question: Are Princess Cruises gratuities charged in US dollars?
faqs.answer: Yes, published rates are stated in USD. Ships operating primarily in Australian dollars charge the equivalent amount in AUD based on regional cruise policies, with specific inclusions for Australia and New Zealand residents.

angelaBio.name: Angela Hughes
angelaBio.title: Princess Cruises Specialist & CEO, Trips & Ships Luxury Travel
angelaBio.bio: Angela Hughes has spent over 40 years as a luxury travel specialist and CEO of Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, having traveled to more than 121 countries. Her firsthand experience across the Princess fleet helps clients navigate cruise budgeting, evaluate whether Princess Plus or Premier covers their gratuities, and avoid unexpected onboard charges.
angelaBio.quote: Factoring Crew Appreciation into your upfront cruise budget eliminates surprises on disembarkation morning. Comparing standalone gratuity totals with the bundled benefits of Princess Plus often reveals that the package pays for itself.

extraTippingDetails.title: Stateroom Stewards
paragraphs: Stateroom attendants service cabins twice daily, replenish towels, provide fresh ice, and prepare evening turndown service. While they participate in the pooled Crew Appreciation fund, an extra cash tip of  to  at the end of the cruise is a customary way to recognize exceptional attention.

lists.title: When to Consider Extra Tipping
items: Immediate fulfillment of special pillow, ice, or laundry requests
Accommodating traveling families with cribs or sofa beds
Delightful daily towel animal artistry and spotless cabin care

extraTippingDetails.title: Dining Room Waitstaff
paragraphs: Main dining room servers, junior waitstaff, and sommeliers work tirelessly each evening. For guests who dine at the same table under Traditional Dining or receive outstanding care in Dine My Way venues, personal gratuities of  to  per server are warmly welcomed.

lists.title: When to Consider Extra Tipping
items: Anticipating dietary restrictions, allergies, and favorite beverage orders
Providing exceptional pacing and warm recommendations across courses
Creating memorable dining moments for birthdays or anniversaries

extraTippingDetails.title: Bartenders & Bar Servers
paragraphs: While drink packages and a la carte beverage purchases automatically include a 20% service charge, slipping a  to  cash tip per drink to your favorite lounge bartender or pool server often results in expedited service and generous pours throughout the cruise.

lists.title: When to Consider Extra Tipping
items: Crafting custom off-menu cocktails tailored to your palate
Remembering your name and preferred drink when you visit the lounge
Prompt poolside service on busy warm-weather sea days

extraTippingDetails.title: Shoreside Porters & Special Crew
paragraphs: Curbside luggage porters at the embarkation terminal are not Princess shipboard crew members and are not compensated by Crew Appreciation. Tipping  to  per bag ensures your luggage is handled securely and staged promptly for shipboard loading.

lists.title: When to Consider Extra Tipping
items: Terminal curbside porters loading checked bags onto terminal carts (–/bag)
Room service delivery crew delivering complimentary or OceanNow meals (–)
Youth center counselors and spa specialists delivering standout care
